title: ACEF Recomputable Severity Vector (ACEF-SEV:1.0)
description: Normative grammar, metric value tables, and band() projection for the ACEF-SEV:1.0 severity vector (RFC-0002 §5.4; ACEF core_version 1.1.0). A self-contained, recomputable, slash-delimited, fixed-order vector string modeled structurally on CVSS v4.0. It is Evidence, not risk: Group I expresses the magnitude of harm if realized, NOT probability-weighted risk (severity-is-not-risk). A vector begins `ACEF-SEV:1.0/` and concatenates `Name:Value` pairs with `/`, in group order I, T, E, S and in the listed order within a group; any omitted optional metric defaults to Not-Defined (X). Group I is mandatory. A present-but-unparseable vector raises ACEF-082 (§7). This schema validates the WIRE-FORMAT string structurally via `pattern` (prefix + the fixed-order metric grammar), and additionally publishes (a) the full normative metric value tables in `$defs/metric_value_tables` and (b) the normative band() table in `$defs/band_table`. Per §5.4: "This table is reproduced normatively in severity_vector.schema.json; the table here governs and the schema file MUST match it" — the band_table below MUST match §5.4 byte-for-meaning. Deterministic data artifact: no wall-clock or random values.
$comment: Wire-format grammar (§5.4): the vector MUST begin `ACEF-SEV:1.0/` and MUST carry the FULL mandatory Group-I sequence in fixed order — HT (harm type), HG (harm gravity), RV (reversibility), SC (scope), BR (breadth) — because §5.4 declares "Group I — Intrinsic Harm (mandatory)" and the band() table keys every row on Group-I metrics (HG, and BR/RV in some rows); a vector lacking any mandatory Group-I metric is UNBANDABLE and is rejected (raises ACEF-082 at validate time, §7). After Group I the vector MAY carry the optional metrics in fixed group order T (RZ,RP,XF), E (AU,EX,KC), S (SF,VL,DB). Each metric appears at most once; omitted OPTIONAL metrics default to Not-Defined (X) per §5.4 (only Groups T/E/S metrics are optional). RP uses the wire form `RP:<rate>@<N>` with rate in [0,1] over N>=1 trials. The full closed value table for every metric is published in $defs/metric_value_tables; the deterministic projection to the coarse `severity` enum is published in $defs/band_table. The example vector from §5.4 (`ACEF-SEV:1.0/HT:R/HG:H/RV:I/SC:C/BR:P/RZ:E/RP:0.62@200/XF:Y/AU:A/EX:H/KC:H/SF:N/VL:F/DB:Y`) validates against this pattern.

severity.description: The coarse `severity` enum carried on the card (§5.4). When `severity_vector` is present, `severity` MUST equal band(severity_vector) per $defs/band_table; a disagreement raises ACEF-088 (§7). This enum is the band() projection TARGET.

metric_value_tables.description: The full normative ACEF-SEV:1.0 metric value tables (§5.4). Each metric belongs to one of four groups evaluated in fixed order I, T, E, S; within a group the metrics appear in the listed order. `mandatory` flags ALL of the Group-I metrics HT, HG, RV, SC, BR — §5.4 declares "Group I — Intrinsic Harm (mandatory)" without exempting any Group-I metric, and the band() table keys its rows on Group-I metrics, so every conforming vector MUST carry the full Group-I sequence to be bandable; the Group T/E/S metrics are optional and default to Not-Defined (X) when omitted. The structural wire-format `pattern` at the schema root encodes the same closed value sets and requires the full Group-I sequence.

HT.name: harm type
HT.description: Harm type keyed to EU Art. 3(49)(a-d) (§5.4).

HG.name: harm gravity
HG.description: ACEF-defined gravity (NOT a CSET mapping; CSET Severity is unbuilt). Mandatory Group-I metric and the primary band() input — every band() row keys on HG, so a vector lacking HG is unbandable.

RV.name: reversibility
RV.description: CVSS v4.0 Recovery semantics; `I` aligns with 3(49)(b) "irreversible". Mandatory Group-I metric and a band() input (the `RV:I` term escalates the band in two rows).

SC.name: scope
SC.description: Whether the harm crosses a security/authorization boundary (CVSS v4.0 scope). Mandatory Group-I metric. Folded into BR by band(), not scored twice (§5.4) — carried as evidence, not a direct band input.

BR.name: affected-population breadth
BR.description: Grounded on the EU "widespread" modifier; ACEF-defined (NOT a built CSET "Spread"). Mandatory Group-I metric and a band() input (the `BR:P` term escalates the band in two rows).

RP.name: reproduction prevalence
RP.description: Wire form `RP:<rate>@<N>`, rate in [0,1] over N>=1 trials (CRFM prevalence recommendation; the wire format is an ACEF construction). RP never changes the band; it informs an optional Assessment-layer risk score only (§5.4).

E.name: Environmental/Contextual
E.description: Risk-tailoring, not severity; carried for a downstream analyst to fold into risk in the Assessment Bundle (§5.4).

band_table.description: NORMATIVE band() projection from the Group-I metrics to the coarse `severity` enum (§5.4). "This table is reproduced normatively in severity_vector.schema.json; the table here governs and the schema file MUST match it" (§5.4) — these rows MUST match §5.4 exactly. Evaluate top-to-bottom; the FIRST matching row wins. Inputs are the Group-I metrics HG (gravity), BR (breadth), RV (reversibility) parsed from the vector. HT (harm type) is deliberately EXCLUDED because harm types are incommensurable (banding by type would smuggle in a cross-type exchange rate the design rejects); SC (scope-changed) is folded into BR rather than scored twice. RP prevalence NEVER changes the band. A card whose `severity` disagrees with the first-match band raises ACEF-088 (§7).
